## YT-DLP Command Builder 1.0.9

- Link Notes now groups tagged Instagram links by their trailing format label, such as `V`, `V1s`, or `V4`.
- Groups stay in the order their labels first appear. Link order within each group and non-link notes are preserved.
- Updated to Android version 1.0.9 (version code 10).

Android 10 or newer. This app only generates commands. It does not download or query Instagram content. Signed with the existing release identity.
